thread:
sasha_cs: quick update — ran a 90m onboarding workshop with Sunrise Analytics this morning. pulled out a short list of feature asks + pain points. dropping the summary here for product triage.

sasha_cs: TL;DR: 5 clustered asks (cost visibility, admin roles, export improvements, webhook reliability, offline evals). majority framed as blockers for wider rollout and renewal discussion next quarter.

mike_success_ops: thanks for this, sasha. client also flagged renewal risk if we don't fix the per-route billing confusion — they showed finance team token-level spikes they couldn't explain.

sasha_cs: exact quote from their head of platform: "We need per-route embeddings cost broken down per project, not a lump monthly charge — otherwise we can't reconcile budgets."

tyler_product: appreciate the summary. can you paste the raw asks with severity and any suggested workarounds they use today? also include whether this is an onboarding-only problem or affects production usage. @anya_eng fyi for feasibility estimates.

sasha_cs: pasted raw notes below (copied from workshop whiteboard):
- Embeddings billing granularity — want per-route + per-batch breakdown; severity: high; current workaround: manual export + rough allocation; impact: blocks procurement sign-off.
- Admin role segmentation — need multi-tenant RBAC inside org (project admins vs billing admins); severity: medium-high; workaround: ad-hoc SSO groups; impact: security review delay.
- Exportable conversation logs — CSV with metadata (route, model, tokens, user-agent) and timezones; severity: medium; workaround: hand-stitched exports via API.
- Webhook delivery reliability — retry policy + DLQ for failed webhook deliveries (esp. when customer system scales down infra); severity: medium; workaround: polling fallback.
- Offline model evaluation / package export — allow them to run evals on-prem for regulated data; severity: low-medium; workaround: sample data export + sanitized tests.

anya_eng: quick feasibility notes: embeddings billing granularity likely requires changes across billing pipeline + attribution layer — moderate effort but clearly impactful. webhook DLQ is more ops work (queue + retry policy) and could be scoped smaller.

tyler_product: propose we slot "embeddings billing granularity" into near-term roadmap if it's truly high renewal risk. can we get an estimate: rough S/M/L? @anya_eng

anya_eng: roughs: embeddings billing granularity = L (cross-system change) but can ship a MVP: per-route daily CSV export in ~2w (M). webhook DLQ + retries = S (~3d) if we reuse existing queue infra. RBAC improvements = M (couple sprints). exports = S-M depending on format. offline packaging = M-L.

mike_success_ops: client asks also for better docs/examples for accounting teams — specifically a sample report template that maps our fields to their GL codes. they said that would temporarily unblock renewals.

sasha_cs: noted — i'll draft a one-page mapping template and send to Mike for review.

tyler_product: next step: Sasha, can you attach the workshop whiteboard pic + sample CSV they used? add those to this thread and we'll convert to a JIRA epic with the MVP scope for embeddings billing export.

sasha_cs: will upload whiteboard + CSV in channel thread shortly. also sharing meeting recording link: https://redwood.example.com/recordings/sunrise-workshop-2026-03-22

deploy-bot: uploaded file "sunrise_whiteboard_03-22.png" (1.4 MB)

tyler_product: great — once we have the artifacts i'll create the epic and tag stakeholders. thanks team! :thumbsup:
